insertions.question: Can you talk about the churn? Many of the apps I've looked at, you know, people are enthusiastic at the beginning, especially the new year. And they kind of drop off as things change, they get busy. So, what keeps them engaged and what do your numbers look like?
Very cool. And how much money have you raised?

So I think what I'm hearing from you is it's a highly kind of product led experience, a la Noom. Are you employing any individual wealth managers or coaches or anyone? Is there any kind of human to human or is it all really product-led feedback based on the data and what you're learning about the person?
Got it. And can you speak more to your intent in the medium to long term to offer various financial services?

Have you noticed any trends in the underlying either demographic or psychographic of the employees that are really excited to use you or like the power users? Are they young? Are they middle aged? Tell us more about that.
What is the user experience when a person leaves his or her employer? Like, is, you know, if, if my money is in your platform, I assume I can still get to it, right?

But let's say that I choose not to pay, like, do I have to offboard? I guess, what happens to my money?
We’ll be right back.
